items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Oh yes, Jelly Roll would hang out there. And Jelly Roll became a name. You know, 'Oh, Jelly Roll is crazy' -- you know how people are.

ctx.x: Was that where he'd hang out?

Oh yes, Jelly Roll would hang out there. And Jelly Roll became a name. You know, 'Oh, Jelly Roll is crazy' -- you know how people are. Because he would always talk, and he'd spend a lot of time on the card games.

items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He was unheard of. I remember as a kid where he used to be on the corner, sat on the corner and preach.

ctx.x: And the same thing with Jelly Roll Morton. He was unheard of. I remember as a kid where he used to be on the corner, sat on the corner and preach.
When you say preach, what do you mean?
